map.AES 和 RSA 区别？: What Is the Difference Between AES and RSA?
map.AES 是对称加密(同一密钥加解密)速度快；RSA 是非对称(公私钥)，适合密钥: AES is symmetric (the same key encrypts and decrypts) and fast; RSA is asymmetric (public and private keys) and suits key exchange.
map.AES(高级加密标准)是应用最广的对称加密算法。本工具支持 AES-128/19: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) is the most widely used symmetric encryption algorithm. This tool supports AES-128/192/256 and the common modes (CBC/GCM/ECB): enter the text and the key to encrypt into Base64 ciphertext or to decrypt in reverse. All computation is done locally in the browser and the key is never uploaded.
map.CBC 需正确 IV，否则解密乱码: CBC requires the correct IV, otherwise the decrypted output is garbled
map.GCM 模式自带完整性校验更安全，ECB 不推荐用于真实数据: GCM mode has built-in integrity checking and is safer; ECB is not recommended for real data
